metadata.market: Binance USDⓈ-M perpetual futures funding schedule; candle input from provided PostgreSQL table
metadata.funding_method: Actual Binance funding settlement timestamps and rates. API markPrice is used when available; Binance Vision archive rows use the previous completed BTCUSDT 15m close as an explicit causal proxy. Funding events within entry or exit boundary candles count payments but ignore potential receipts.
metadata.label_cost_components: Model barriers are calibrated to commission plus slippage; variable historical funding is applied only to post-prediction trade PnL.
metadata.fees: Entry and exit commission use notional at each fill; exit notional scales with exit/entry price.
metadata.slippage: User-defined round-trip stress assumption; not estimated from order-book replay.
metadata.capital_method: No leverage assumed. Position notional is capped by $25/$50/$100 and 90% of current equity by default; no upward sizing above the selected cap.
metadata.capital_comparison_rule: OOS and untouched-holdout portfolio simulations each start from the initial capital independently; their PnL values must not be added together.
metadata.multiple_comparison_warning: Fee, slippage and selection grids create multiple candidate results. Choose candidates on development folds only, then confirm once on a new forward period; do not select a winner from the holdout table.
metadata.risk_limitations: No exchange maintenance-margin or liquidation engine, order-book queue/fill probability, exact intrabar exit seconds, taxes, or withdrawal costs.
